title: SST 102 - Soil Chemistry, Fertility and Conservation

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Soil survey.
o: a soil with excess sodium on its exchange sites, which destroys structure
the field mapping and description of the soils of an area
the matching of land units to the uses they can sustain
a soil holding enough soluble salt to harm crop growth
items.s: Soil survey: the field mapping and description of the soils of an area. The other options describe Land use planning, Sodic soil, Saline soil.

items.q: Fertiliser burn may be defined as
o: erosion that cuts small channels a few centimetres deep
the removal of dry loose soil by wind, worst on bare sandy land
the measure of the acidity or alkalinity of a soil

items.s: Fertiliser burn: injury to plants from too much fertiliser salt placed close to roots. The other options describe Rill erosion, Wind erosion, Soil pH.

items.s: Soil series: a group of soils with similar profile and parent material. The other options describe Soil map, Magnesium, Crop rotation.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Cation exchange?

items.s: Cation exchange: the swapping of positively charged nutrient ions between soil particles and soil solution. The other options describe Check dam, Law of the minimum, Agricultural intensification.
